# partiteai_mcp_connection_tunnel_key (Resource)

A relay credential for one subscription of a tunnel MCP connection.

A key names exactly one subscription and a relay names nothing, so a relay can only reach the subscription its key was issued for.

The credential is returned when the key is created and is never readable again, so it is held in Terraform state. Treat the state as a secret.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `label` (String) Names the key for an operator, so `laptop-bob` can be told from `ci` without decoding anything.
- `mcp_connection_id` (String) The connection the subscription belongs to. A key is reached through its connection, so this is named rather than derived.
- `mcp_connection_subscription_id` (String) The subscription this key serves.

### Optional

- `expires_at` (String) When the key stops working. Left out, it does not expire and is withdrawn by destroying it.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the resource was created
- `credential` (String, Sensitive) The credential to configure on a relay, as `PARTITE_RELAY_TOKEN`. It exists in this form once, so it is kept in state and cannot be recovered from the API.
- `id` (String) Resource identifier
- `revoked_at` (String) When the key was withdrawn, if it has been.
